headline: GOLD SURGES 2%+ AS CPI POSTS STEEPEST MONTHLY DROP SINCE APRIL 2020 — June Headline 3.5% vs 3.8% Expected, Core Slips to 2.6%; Spot Rebounds to $4,084 From Two-Week Low
snippet: Gold spot climbed 2.1% to $4,083.99 per ounce on July 14 after June CPI came in at 3.5% year-on-year — sharply below the 3.8% consensus — as headline inflation fell 0.4% month-on-month, its steepest single-month decline since April 2020, and core CPI decelerated to 2.6% from 2.9%. The print eased pressure on the Federal Reserve ahead of the July 28-29 FOMC meeting, weakened the U.S. dollar, and pulled 10-year Treasury yields off intraday highs — reversing an earlier selloff that had dragged gold to a two-week low as oil-driven inflation fears from the US-Iran Strait of Hormuz escalation temporarily dominated.

headline: U.S. REINSTATES IRAN NAVAL BLOCKADE, CHARGES 20% HORMUZ FEE — Brent Crude +14% in Five Days; Silver Hits December 2025 Lows Before CPI-Driven Bounce
snippet: The United States reinstated its naval blockade on Iranian ports and instituted a 20% escort fee for commercial ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz, sending Brent crude surging nearly 14% in five trading sessions and compressing silver to its lowest levels since December 2025 — near $58 per ounce, more than 52% below silver's January 2026 all-time high of $121.64. The Iranian escalation raised the threat of oil-driven inflation reigniting just as the Federal Reserve debates whether to hike further, creating a rare competing-forces setup across commodities before a softer-than-expected CPI report reversed the pressure on gold and silver on July 14.

headline: TOREX RUNS 16 RIGS AT MORELOS, HITS 18.5 g/t AuEq — Q2 Update: 95m AT 1.5 g/t Au, 49m AT 2.18 g/t; 62,500m 2026 Program Eyes Life Extension at Mexico Gold Complex (TSX:TXG)
snippet: Torex Gold Resources Inc. (TSX: TXG) released its Q2 2026 Morelos drilling update on July 13, reporting 16 drill rigs simultaneously active at the Media Luna Cluster — part of a 62,500-metre 2026 program targeting resource growth at Media Luna, Media Luna North, and Media Luna East in Guerrero State, Mexico. Headline intercepts include 9.14 g/t AuEq over 7.5 metres and a peak of 18.5 g/t AuEq from the ELG Underground, plus wider hits of 95 metres at 1.5 g/t gold from approximately 700 metres depth and 49 metres at 2.18 g/t gold — results management says reinforce the strategy to grow reserves and extend the Morelos Complex beyond its current production timeline.

headline: MINERS' Q2 PROFITS SECOND-BEST EVER AT $2,787/oz — Hamilton: GDX TRADES AT 20x P/E AS SECTOR POSTS NEAR-RECORD EARNINGS THE MARKET ISN'T PRICING IN (GoldSeek)
snippet: Analyst Adam Hamilton calculates in a new GoldSeek piece that the GDX top 25 gold miners are tracking toward their second-best quarter on record — with a Q2 2026 average gold price near $4,512 per ounce generating implied unit profits of $2,787/oz, up 50% year-over-year from Q2 2025's $1,861 — while the sector's stock correction has collapsed trailing P/E ratios to approximately 20x, near where they traded when gold was $3,500 and profits were a fraction of current levels. Hamilton frames the disconnect as historically anomalous: a sector reporting second-highest profits ever while priced as if earnings will permanently revert, a setup that has historically resolved sharply in miners' favour.

headline: $372M GOLDGROUP-GOLD RESOURCE DEAL CLOSES JULY 17 — Cerro Prieto, Don David, and Michigan's Back Forty Combine Into New Mexico-Focused Precious Metals Producer
snippet: Goldgroup Mining Inc. and Gold Resource Corporation (NYSE American: GORO) are set to close their US$372 million merger on or about July 17, 2026, following shareholder approval on July 2 — with each GORO share converting to 0.3619 post-consolidation Goldgroup shares after a four-for-one Goldgroup share consolidation. The combined company will hold the Cerro Prieto heap-leach gold mine and San Francisco development project in Sonora, the Don David gold-silver mine in Oaxaca, and the Back Forty development project in Michigan, creating one of the few small-cap precious metals producers with simultaneous operations in two Mexican states and a North American development pipeline.

headline: WESTERN URANIUM'S MUSTANG MILL LICENSE ON TRACK FOR Q4 SUBMISSION — Colorado 1,000-tpd Uranium Facility Preserves All of 2027 for CDPHE Regulatory Review (CSE:WUC)
snippet: Western Uranium & Vanadium Corp. (CSE: WUC) confirmed on July 14 that baseline data collection for the Mustang Mineral Processing Plant in Colorado — a former uranium mill site — is substantially complete, with water monitoring finished and air monitoring extended into Q2 2026 after equipment repair. The company remains on track to submit its radioactive materials license application to the Colorado CDPHE by late Q4 2026, deliberately preserving all of calendar year 2027 for the regulatory review window; Mustang is designed for 1,000 tonnes per day throughput and targeted for modular construction once licensed, positioned to serve US domestic uranium supply security objectives.

headline: CHILE MAY COPPER FALLS 13% YEAR-ON-YEAR — UBS SEES 520K-TONNE 2026 DEFICIT as Grade Decline, Water Shortages, and Oxide-Sulfide Transition Converge on the World's Top Copper Nation
snippet: Chilean copper production fell nearly 13% year-on-year in May 2026 as declining ore grades, water supply constraints, unplanned maintenance, labour disputes, and the oxide-to-sulfide mining transition converged on the world's largest copper-producing nation, which supplies roughly 50% of global copper exports. UBS forecasts a 520,000-tonne refined copper deficit for 2026 — J.P. Morgan projects 330,000 tonnes — helping support copper futures near $6.26 per pound even as US tariff policy uncertainty creates near-term price volatility; analysts note the structural supply constraint is independent of demand cycles and unlikely to reverse quickly given capital allocation timelines.

headline: ALL 18 RARE EARTH ELEMENTS RISE IN JULY — Germanium +27.8%, Dysprosium +25.4%, Average Basket +16.7%; Zero Declines as Western Processing Race Intensifies
snippet: All 18 rare earth elements tracked on major price indices posted gains in July 2026, with the basket averaging 16.7% upside and no elements declining — led by germanium (+27.8%), indium (+26.5%), and dysprosium (+25.4%), the latter critical for high-temperature permanent magnets in EV motors, wind turbines, and defence systems. The broad-based strength reflects persistent supply-chain geopolitics as China maintains dominant processing control while Western producers including USA Rare Earth, Energy Fuels, and MP Materials race to build separation capacity, with government procurement programs and AI-driven demand for speciality magnets and semiconductors adding structural demand pressure.

headline: 'BOTTOM-TYPE ACTION FORMING' IN GOLD AND SILVER — GoldSeek: 27% Au and 52% Ag Corrections Hit Historical Bull-Market Reversal Range; July 28-29 FOMC Is the Final Gate
snippet: GoldSeek analysts published technical analysis this week pointing to classic bottoming patterns forming across gold and silver, noting that gold's 27% correction from its January 2026 all-time high of $5,589 and silver's 52% correction from $121.64 fall within the historical magnitude range of major bull-market pullbacks that have preceded significant new advances. Momentum indicators are turning upward, prices are returning to key moving averages, and the July 14 soft CPI print appears to mark a technical inflection point — though analysts caution that the Federal Reserve's July 28-29 FOMC decision remains the definitive catalyst for confirming whether the correction is complete or temporarily pausing.

headline: INTREPID METALS ADDS CURLY GOLD PORPHYRY TARGET AT ARIZONA CORRAL — Phase 1 Returns 5.94% Cu; 65km IP Survey Opens in August Ahead of 10,000m September Drill Campaign (TSXV:INTR)
snippet: Intrepid Metals Corp. (TSXV: INTR) reported Phase 1 results from its 2026 Corral Copper Property program in Cochise County, Arizona — including copper assays up to 5.94% Cu from 1,352 rock samples across CRD and porphyry copper-gold targets — and announced program expansion including the newly defined Curly gold porphyry target and a 65 line-kilometre induced polarization survey commencing early August. Approximately 5,000 of a planned 10,000-metre drill campaign are earmarked to test priority porphyry targets in September, with Teck Resources Ltd. providing ongoing technical input into target generation at this historic Arizona copper district.
